git clone https://github.com/kleberandrade/chatbot-aulas-flutter.git
cd chatbot-aulas-flutter
flutter --version
flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
flutter run -d chrome

name: chatbot
description: A safe, offline-first conversational classroom for Flutter and Dialogflow concepts.
publish_to: none
version: 2.0.0+2
environment:
  sdk: ^3.14.0
  flutter: '>=3.50.0'
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  material_ui: ^1.11.1
dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_lints: ^6.0.0
flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
flutter analyze --fatal-infos
flutter test --coverage
flutter build web --release
